note: convex hulls of the gripper's visual parts, body frame, jaws fully open (vehicle manual drawing as data); parts_closed: the same with the jaws closed; marker_held: the leak marker in the jaws

frame.axes: x forward, y left, z up

half_gap_mm.note: open jaws: half the vertical gap between the jaw faces at a distance s behind the tips

entry_window_mm.note: a horizontal blade fits between the open jaws at bite b if |dz| <= a0 - slope * b

marker_held.frame: vehicle body frame, marker at its grasp in the jaws
